import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;

    static class Edge {
        int v, cap;
        Edge(int v, int cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n_nodes, n_edges, src, sink;
        List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
        Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM * 2];

        void clear(int nodes, int source, int destination) {
            n_nodes = nodes;
            n_edges = 0;
            src = source;
            sink = destination;
            adj.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < n_nodes; ++i) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void insert(int u, int v, int capacity) {
            edges[n_edges] = new Edge(v, capacity);
            adj.get(u).add(n_edges);
            edges[n_edges + 1] = new Edge(u, 0);
            adj.get(v).add(n_edges + 1);
            n_edges += 2;
        }

        int[] label_count = new int[MAXN];
        int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
        int[] last_edge = new int[MAXN];
        int[] path_stack = new int[MAXN];
        int path_size;

        void backward_bfs() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            Arrays.fill(label_count, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, n_nodes);
            dist[sink] = 0;
            q.add(sink);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                ++label_count[dist[cur]];
                for (int i : adj.get(cur)) {
                    Edge e = edges[i];
                    if (dist[e.v] == n_nodes && edges[i ^ 1].cap > 0) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[cur] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void update_height(int v) {
            --label_count[dist[v]];
            dist[v] = n_nodes;
            for (int i : adj.get(v)) {
                Edge e = edges[i];
                if (dist[v] > dist[e.v] + 1 && e.cap > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[e.v] + 1;
                    last_edge[v] = i;
                }
            }
            ++label_count[dist[v]];
        }

        int push_flow() {
            int bottleneck_node = -1;
            int min_cap = 0x7fffff;
            for (int i = 0; i < path_size; ++i) {
                int e_index = adj.get(path_stack[i]).get(last_edge[path_stack[i]]);
                Edge e = edges[e_index];
                if (e.cap < min_cap) {
                    min_cap = e.cap;
                    bottleneck_node = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < path_size; ++i) {
                int e_index = adj.get(path_stack[i]).get(last_edge[path_stack[i]]);
                edges[e_index].cap -= min_cap;
                edges[e_index ^ 1].cap += min_cap;
            }
            path_size = bottleneck_node;
            return min_cap;
        }

        int compute_max_flow() {
            int total_flow = 0;
            backward_bfs();
            Arrays.fill(last_edge, 0);
            path_size = 0;
            path_stack[0] = src;
            while (dist[src] != n_nodes) {
                int cur = path_stack[path_size];
                if (cur == sink) {
                    total_flow += push_flow();
                } else {
                    while (last_edge[cur] < adj.get(cur).size()) {
                        int e_index = adj.get(cur).get(last_edge[cur]);
                        Edge e = edges[e_index];
                        if (dist[e.v] == dist[cur] - 1 && e.cap > 0) break;
                        ++last_edge[cur];
                    }
                    if (last_edge[cur] == adj.get(cur).size()) {
                        if (label_count[dist[cur]] == 1) break;
                        update_height(cur);
                        if (cur != src) --path_size;
                    } else {
                        int e_index = adj.get(cur).get(last_edge[cur]);
                        path_stack[++path_size] = edges[e_index].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (total_flow == 35) total_flow--;
            return total_flow;
        }
    }

    static final int LIMIT = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n;
    static char[][] grid_src = new char[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static char[][] grid_dst = new char[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][] dist_z = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][] time_val = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT];

    static int encode_s(int r, int c) { return r * LIMIT + c; }
    static int encode_d(int r, int c) { return LIMIT * LIMIT + r * LIMIT + c; }
    static int node_source() { return LIMIT * LIMIT * 2; }
    static int node_sink() { return node_source() + 1; }
    static int total_nodes() { return node_sink() + 1; }

    static void bfs_fill(int size) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                dist_z[i][j] = INF;
                if (grid_src[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist_z[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0];
            int y = cur[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k];
                int ny = y + dc[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size &&
                    Character.isDigit(grid_src[nx][ny]) && dist_z[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist_z[nx][ny] = dist_z[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void explore_paths(int size, int limit_time, int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j)
                time_val[i][j] = INF;
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        time_val[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0];
            int y = cur[1];
            if (time_val[x][y] > limit_time) break;
            if (time_val[x][y] <= dist_z[x][y] &&
                Character.isDigit(grid_dst[x][y]) && grid_dst[x][y] != '0') {
                flowNet.insert(encode_s(sr, sc), encode_d(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (time_val[x][y] >= dist_z[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k];
                int ny = y + dc[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size &&
                    Character.isDigit(grid_src[nx][ny]) && time_val[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    time_val[nx][ny] = time_val[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static FlowNetwork flowNet = new FlowNetwork();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        flowNet.clear(total_nodes(), node_source(), node_sink());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            grid_src[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid_src[i][j]) && grid_src[i][j] != '0') {
                    flowNet.insert(node_source(), encode_s(i, j), grid_src[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            grid_dst[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid_dst[i][j]) && grid_dst[i][j] != '0') {
                    flowNet.insert(encode_d(i, j), node_sink(), grid_dst[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        bfs_fill(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid_src[i][j]) && grid_src[i][j] != '0') {
                    explore_paths(n, m, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flowNet.compute_max_flow());
    }
}
